notes: CURRENT-MONTH end-of-month SAVINGS is now live-anchored instead of planned-chain-anchored. PROBLEM: the Projection sheet's bottom 'Savings (end of month)' row computed the current month as prev_chain_value x (1 + monthly cash rate) + planned residue. Because the prior month's chain value was itself seeded from that month's PLANNED close rather than its ACTUAL close, the divergence rode forward — for Aug 26 the row showed Rs 7,92,397 while the live savings balance was already Rs 8,44,600. A projected close BELOW the money already sitting in the account is nonsensical to read, and the ~Rs 38.5K gap was purely accumulated planned-vs-actual drift, NOT any real expected outflow (remaining planned spend for the month was in fact Rs 0, since actual spend of Rs 2,00,173 had already overshot the Rs 1,72,557 plan). FIX: for the current month only, EOM savings = live savings balance - max(0, CC outstanding - max(0, salary account balance)). Rationale: the live savings balance already embeds every event so far this month (salary credited, transfers completed, all logged expenses and investment contributions). The single thing it does not yet reflect is the month-end credit-card settlement. Salary is a transit account that zeroes out at month end, so it pays the card down first and savings funds only the shortfall. For Aug 26: Rs 8,44,600 live - Rs 13,742 shortfall (Rs 43,400 card - Rs 29,658 salary) = Rs 8,30,858. SELF-UPDATING: because the figure derives from the live balance, every additional expense logged before month end lowers it automatically — no re-plan, no reconciliation step. KNOCK-ON (intended, no extra code): the Account Balances top row for a future month already reads the prior month's chain value, so Sep 26 start-of-month now shows Rs 8,30,858 instead of Rs 7,92,397, and each later month re-bases off the corrected value. Verified in-browser: Aug EOM 8,30,858 -> Sep top row 8,30,858 -> Sep EOM 9,40,021 -> Oct top row 9,40,021. EDGE CASES VERIFIED: salary fully covers the card (savings contributes 0); no credit-card account configured (contributes 0); salary account negative (savings funds the entire card balance); CC balance stored with either sign (Math.abs applied); a further Rs 10K expense correctly drops EOM to Rs 8,20,858.
